text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Gold 
City. It happened just as we passed the 
bookstore in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that magazine from the other day... 
Huh, they've got stacks of it displayed 
here too.
choice_data_list:
For the special feature on model-picked 
outfits?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Right, the one you came with me to the 
mall for."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Since I was able to try it out there, it 
went over really well on set. Thanks.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I was able to help.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mind if I check out the books while 
we're here?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This one, and this one... Oh, and this one 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The books Gold City picked out piled 
higher and higher in the shopping basket 
placed on the floor...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, mixed in with the magazines 
were several serious paperback books.
choice_data_list: (Do I have to read all of this...?)

(I wonder if I have to read all of 
this...?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh my, if it isn't City-san~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa~, you sure are buying a lot of books!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I read it inside the location bus 
or during breaks at work."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see~...! You're gonna read this 
difficult-looking one then, too?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, someone I worked with recommended it 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"It gives us something to talk about at 
our next job, right? That's why I make 
sure to read them all."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"A capable career woman like City-san... 
S-She's even cooler now~!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait, by the way... Do you buy that 
many training books too, Yukino?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the shopping basket Gold City points to 
is a massive stack of training books. It 
looks like Yukino Bijin picked them out, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, ah... ehehe. While I was trying to 
decide, they just kept piling up."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...This might be none of my business, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Rather than stacking up more books, you're 
better off reading this thoroughly. My 
trainer reads it, too.
choice_data_list: You even read the book I was reading?
You even read the books I've been reading?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Training's easier if we're both on the 
same page, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean... yeah, I think you pick good 
books. I'm actually using them as 
reference.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even when busy, Gold City never cuts 
corners, tackling everything with utmost 
seriousness."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything I can do to help 
her...
choice_data_list: Recommend a training book to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recommended a book that, when read 
alongside the one Gold City suggested 
earlier, would help her understand the 
content even better.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~. This one's quite a bit more 
compact than the others, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I don't think there's anything to 
worry about, is there?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to training, I've got a good 
eye... right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but smile at Gold City's 
words. I decided to buy the two 
recommended books and give them to the 
girls as a present.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To learn more about the modeling 
profession, I decided to purchase the 
autobiography of a famous model.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why? Modeling work isn't really a 
trainer's domain, is it?
choice_data_list:
We should have a shared understanding, 
right?

We should make sure we're on the same 
page, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I told Gold City that since she was 
giving it her all, I wanted to answer with 
everything I had too."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing! It feels just like a teen 
drama~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
W-What's that supposed to mean? It's not 
like that at all, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I appreciate the sentiment, 
Trainer.
